title: 005 人物愿望清单006 我可是为了任务
slug: 从小欢喜开启诸天之旅
content_zh:
来到班里，陆泽就趴在桌子上开始了刻苦的学习，自己毕竟已经远离高中多年，脑海里的高中知识早已经消退大半，必须抓紧时间重新捡起来。
唯一庆幸的可能是如今陆泽的年龄是十八岁。
这个年纪无疑是男人最好的一个年纪，精力、活力、记忆力以及其他能力都处在最巅峰的时候。
当然，这时候如果有外挂的帮助那才叫做真正的如虎添翼。
所以陆泽毫不犹豫的选择唤醒脑海里的系统，个人面板随即出现。
【宿主：陆泽】
【当前所处世界：小欢喜】
【身份：春风中学高三学生】
【精神：7】
【体质：6】
【力量：5】
【敏捷：5】
【技能：驾驶入门LV1（本本族）；厨艺入门LV1（西红柿炒蛋专业户）】
【系统可分配点数：0】
在小欢喜世界里，对于学习有效果的属性显然是精神，但是目前陆泽的手上并没有可分配的系统点数。
系统自从发布完跟英子的那個任务以后就陷入到了沉寂当中。
这显然不是个话痨的系统。
陆泽看着可分配分数那一栏的鸭蛋，在心里默默问道：“系统，有什么办法可以获得分配点数吗？”
系统半天没有反应。
而就在陆泽有些失望的时候，脑海里忽然响起一阵机械音。

【叮咚！】
【宿主帮助完成当前世界的人物愿望清单可以获取系统点数。】
【检测到宿主目前处于小欢喜世界，是否开启当前世界人物愿望清单？】
陆泽心头一喜，确认开启。
在刚来到这个世界的时候，陆泽确定系统并没有这样类似的提示。
可能是因为现在小欢喜世界的原著剧情正式开启，脑海当中的系统相对应也开启了相关联的功能。
【愿望清单：
方一凡的愿望：昨天下午放学的方一凡被教导主任李萌叫到了办公室，得知了自己可能要蹲班的情况，宿主帮助方一凡摆脱蹲班困扰，可获得系统奖励点数：2
乔英子的愿望：父母之间因为离婚变得关系不好，这影响到了乔英子的身心健康，宿主帮助乔英子解决原生家庭的问题，可获得系统奖励点数：随机
季杨杨的愿望：刚刚拿到驾驶证的季杨杨非常想要体验真正开车的感觉，宿主帮助季杨杨完成开车愿望，可获得系统奖励点数：2
...
王一笛的愿望：鲇鱼精也想春天，女孩王一笛梦想着跟科学家谈一场轰轰烈烈的恋爱，帮助王一笛完成恋爱愿望，宿主可获得系统奖励点数：6】
琳琅满目的愿望清单让陆泽看花了眼。
其中甚至于还有王一笛这种有些奇葩的恋爱愿望。
陆泽大概浏览了一遍，然后将自己的第一个目标放在了季杨杨的愿望上面。
毕竟，表弟这个熟人好下手，而且原著里面的季杨杨还因为把法拉利开进学校跟方一凡引发了冲突，后面连锁反应导致还当众挨了季胜利一巴掌。
开车这个愿望，相对而言比较容易实现。
至于其他的愿望清单，陆泽只能选择走一步看一步。
content_en:
When he came to class, Lu Ze lay down on the table and started studying hard. After all, he had been away from high school for many years, and most of the high school knowledge in his mind had faded, so he had to seize the time to pick it up again.
The only good thing may be that Lu Ze is now eighteen years old.
This age is undoubtedly the best age for men, when energy, vitality, memory and other abilities are at their peak.
Of course, if you have the help of plug-ins at this time, it will be truly even more powerful.
So Lu Ze chose to wake up the system in his mind without hesitation, and the personal panel appeared immediately.
[Host: Lu Ze]
[Current World: Little Joy]
[Identity: Senior high school student at Chunfeng Middle School]
【Spirit: 7】
[Physique: 6]
【Strength: 5】
[Agility: 5]
[Skills: LV1 for beginners in driving (for this family); LV1 for beginners in cooking (professional with tomatoes and scrambled eggs)]
[The system can allocate points: 0]
In the world of Little Joy, the attribute that is effective for learning is obviously spirit, but currently Lu Ze has no system points to allocate.
The system has fallen into silence since the mission with Yingzi was released.
This is obviously not a chatty system.
Lu Ze looked at the duck eggs in the column of assignable points and asked silently in his mind: "System, is there any way to get assigned points?"
The system did not respond for a long time.
Just when Lu Ze was a little disappointed, a mechanical sound suddenly sounded in his mind.
[Ding dong! 】
[The host can obtain system points by helping to complete the character wish list in the current world. 】
[It is detected that the host is currently in the Xiaohuanxi world. Do you want to open the wish list of characters in the current world? 】
Lu Ze felt happy and confirmed that it was turned on.
When he first came to this world, Lu Ze was sure that the system did not have such a similar prompt.
Maybe it's because the original plot of Little Happy World is now officially launched, and the system in my mind has correspondingly opened related functions.
[Wish list:
Fang Yifan’s wish: After school yesterday afternoon, Fang Yifan was called to the office by Li Meng, the teaching director, and learned that he might have to work in class. The host can help Fang Yifan get rid of the problem of working in class, and he can get system reward points: 2
Qiao Yingzi's wish: The relationship between her parents has become bad due to divorce, which has affected Qiao Yingzi's physical and mental health. The host can help Qiao Yingzi solve the problems of her original family and get system reward points: Randomly
Ji Yangyang's wish: Ji Yangyang, who has just obtained his driver's license, really wants to experience the feeling of real driving. The host helps Ji Yangyang fulfill his wish to drive, and he will receive system reward points: 2
...
Wang Yidi’s wish: The catfish spirit also wants spring. The girl Wang Yidi dreams of having a vigorous love affair with a scientist. Help Wang Yidi fulfill his love wish. The host can obtain system reward points: 6]
Lu Ze was dazzled by the dazzling array of wish lists.
Among them, there is even Wang Yidi's somewhat bizarre desire for love.
Lu Ze browsed through it briefly, and then set his first target on Ji Yangyang's wish.
After all, the cousin is an acquaintance who is easy to attack, and in the original book, Ji Yangyang also caused a conflict with Fang Yifan because he drove a Ferrari into the school. The chain reaction later led to Ji Yangyang being slapped in public by Ji Yangyang.
The desire to drive is relatively easy to realize.
As for the rest of his wish list, Lu Ze could only choose to take it one step at a time.
